author: American, British, French and Japanese representatives in China

limits: The banking consortium’s existence does not establish adoption or funding of Sun’s integrated organization.

author: Chinese Peasants and Workers Democratic Party

locator: Opening paragraph; sections 港口立项之争, 一波三折的项目论证, 一花引来百花开
supports: Participant account of 1997–2004 advocacy and approval disputes; opening ceremony dated 16 December 2005.
limits: Participant's credit-claiming institutional narrative, not independent assessment or original State Council approval text.

author: Deng Chaojun [邓朝军]
title: 从史志回望成渝双城的交通联接 [Looking back through local histories at transport connections between Chengdu and Chongqing]

supports: Places Chengdu–Chongqing in the late-Qing Sichuan–Hankou railway lineage; records a 1932 preparatory office and Republican surveys, earthworks, roadbeds, small bridges and culverts before 1949.
limits: Retrospective official history, rather than the engineering dossiers. It does not identify exactly which earlier work was reused in 1950.

author: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in New Zealand
title: Chronology of Three Gorges Project
publisher_or_journal: PRC Embassy website; posted 27 October 2003, text dateline 5 November 1997
supports: Official retrospective chronology of design suspension, PRC studies, approval and construction.
limits: Retrospective official narrative; not independent proof of a continuous engineering design or uncontroversial social outcomes.

publisher_or_journal: National Energy Administration, 5 July 2012 (Xinhua dispatch 4 July)
locator: Entries 10 July 2003 and 4 July 2012
supports: First generating unit in July 2003 and final major unit in July 2012; stated total installed capacity 22.5 GW.
limits: Commissioning dates for generation are distinct from completion or acceptance of all project functions.

author: General Office of the Beijing Municipal People's Government

limits: Does not establish a continuous institutional connection to Sun's proposal. Archival webpage URL carries a later migration date.
